schema.help: We ask because money can limit how people get around.

options.text: We struggle to cover basic needs
We cover basic needs easily, with little left over
We can afford most things, with some extras now and then
We are very comfortable and can easily afford extras

schema.text: Thinking about the income of everyone who lives with you, which of these best describes your household's economic situation?

ar.#Thinking about the income of everyone w: بالنظر إلى دخل جميع الأشخاص الذين يعيشون معك، أي من هذه الخيارات يصف الوضع الاقتصادي لأسرتك بشكل أفضل؟
ar.#We are very comfortable and can easily: وضعنا المالي مريح جدًا ونستطيع تحمّل المصاريف الإضافية بسهولة
ar.#We ask because money can limit how peop: نسأل لأن المال قد يحدّ من طريقة تنقّل الناس.
ar.#We can afford most things, with some ex: نستطيع تحمّل معظم الأشياء، مع بعض المصاريف الإضافية أحيانًا
ar.#We cover basic needs easily, with littl: نغطي الاحتياجات الأساسية بسهولة، لكن يتبقى القليل
ar.#We struggle to cover basic needs: نواجه صعوبة في تغطية الاحتياجات الأساسية

de.#Thinking about the income of everyone w: Wenn Sie an das Einkommen aller Personen denken, die mit Ihnen zusammenleben: Welche dieser Aussagen beschreibt die wirtschaftliche Situation Ihres Haushalts am besten?
de.#We are very comfortable and can easily: Uns geht es finanziell sehr gut, Extras sind leicht möglich
de.#We ask because money can limit how peop: Wir fragen, weil Geld einschränken kann, wie Menschen unterwegs sind.
de.#We can afford most things, with some ex: Wir können uns das meiste leisten, ab und zu auch etwas extra
de.#We can cover basic needs: Wir können unsere grundlegenden Bedürfnisse bezahlen
de.#We cover basic needs easily, with littl: Wir decken den Grundbedarf problemlos, aber es bleibt wenig übrig
de.#We struggle to cover basic needs: Wir haben Schwierigkeiten, unsere grundlegenden Bedürfnisse zu bezahlen

en.#Thinking about the income of everyone w: Thinking about the income of everyone who lives with you, which of these best describes your household's economic situation?
en.#We are very comfortable and can easily: We are very comfortable and can easily afford extras
en.#We ask because money can limit how peop: We ask because money can limit how people get around.
en.#We can afford most things, with some ex: We can afford most things, with some extras now and then
en.#We cover basic needs easily, with littl: We cover basic needs easily, with little left over
en.#We struggle to cover basic needs: We struggle to cover basic needs

fa.#Thinking about the income of everyone w: با در نظر گرفتن درآمد همه کسانی که با شما زندگی می‌کنند، کدام یک از این گزینه‌ها وضعیت اقتصادی خانواده شما را بهتر توصیف می‌کند؟
fa.#We are very comfortable and can easily: وضع مالی‌مان بسیار خوب است و هزینه‌های اضافی را به‌راحتی می‌پردازیم
fa.#We ask because money can limit how peop: این را می‌پرسیم چون پول می‌تواند نحوه جابه‌جایی افراد را محدود کند.
fa.#We can afford most things, with some ex: بیشتر چیزها را می‌توانیم تهیه کنیم و گاهی هزینه اضافی هم داریم
fa.#We can cover basic needs: می‌توانیم نیازهای اولیه را تأمین کنیم
fa.#We cover basic needs easily, with littl: نیازهای اولیه را به‌راحتی تأمین می‌کنیم، اما پول کمی می‌ماند
fa.#We struggle to cover basic needs: برای تأمین نیازهای اولیه مشکل داریم

fr.#Thinking about the income of everyone w: En pensant aux revenus de toutes les personnes qui vivent avec vous, laquelle de ces propositions décrit le mieux la situation économique de votre foyer ?
fr.#We are very comfortable and can easily: Nous sommes très à l’aise et pouvons facilement faire des dépenses supplémentaires
fr.#We ask because money can limit how peop: Nous posons cette question parce que l’argent peut limiter la façon dont les personnes se déplacent.
fr.#We can afford most things, with some ex: Nous pouvons nous permettre presque tout, avec quelques extras de temps en temps
fr.#We can cover basic needs: Nous pouvons couvrir nos besoins essentiels
fr.#We cover basic needs easily, with littl: Nous couvrons facilement nos besoins essentiels, mais il nous reste peu
fr.#We struggle to cover basic needs: Nous avons du mal à couvrir nos besoins essentiels

hu.#Thinking about the income of everyone w: Ha az Önnel együtt élő összes személy jövedelmére gondol, melyik írja le legjobban a háztartása anyagi helyzetét?
hu.#We are very comfortable and can easily: Nagyon jó anyagi helyzetben vagyunk, könnyen megengedhetünk extrákat
hu.#We ask because money can limit how peop: Azért kérdezzük, mert az anyagi helyzet korlátozhatja, hogyan közlekednek az emberek.
hu.#We can afford most things, with some ex: A legtöbb dolgot megengedhetjük magunknak, néha extrákat is
hu.#We cover basic needs easily, with littl: Az alapvető szükségleteket könnyen fedezzük, de kevés marad
hu.#We struggle to cover basic needs: Alig jut pénzünk az alapvető kiadásokra

it.#Thinking about the income of everyone w: Pensando al reddito di tutte le persone che vivono con te, quale di queste descrive meglio la situazione economica del tuo nucleo familiare?
it.#We are very comfortable and can easily: Stiamo molto bene e possiamo permetterci facilmente spese extra
it.#We ask because money can limit how peop: Lo chiediamo perché il denaro può limitare il modo in cui le persone si spostano.
it.#We can afford most things, with some ex: Possiamo permetterci quasi tutto, con qualche spesa extra ogni tanto
it.#We can cover basic needs: Riusciamo a coprire le necessità di base
it.#We cover basic needs easily, with littl: Copriamo facilmente le necessità di base, ma ci resta poco
it.#We struggle to cover basic needs: Abbiamo difficoltà a coprire le necessità di base

tr.#Thinking about the income of everyone w: Sizinle birlikte yaşayan herkesin gelirini düşündüğünüzde, aşağıdakilerden hangisi hanenizin ekonomik durumunu en iyi tanımlar?
tr.#We are very comfortable and can easily: Maddi durumumuz çok iyi, ekstra harcamaları kolayca yapabiliyoruz
tr.#We ask because money can limit how peop: Bunu soruyoruz çünkü para, insanların nasıl yolculuk ettiğini sınırlayabilir.
tr.#We can afford most things, with some ex: Çoğu şeyi karşılayabiliyoruz, ara sıra ekstra harcama da yapabiliyoruz
tr.#We cover basic needs easily, with littl: Temel ihtiyaçları rahatça karşılıyoruz ama az para kalıyor
